Step Behind the Mask

Join us at The Arts Theatre Club in the heart of Soho for an evening of mystery, glamour and meaningful connection. Slip on your mask, leave the small talk at the door, and meet fellow singles in an intimate, beautifully atmospheric setting where every conversation begins with a little intrigue.

Your evening begins with a drink on us, and the night unfolds from there - candlelit corners, curious introductions and, for those who dare, a glimpse into what the cards have in store. All the while, the best of the 80s and 90s will be playing - the soundtrack to your next great first impression.

Hosted by a Professional Matchmaker

Your evening is hosted by Sparked Connection's professional matchmaker, Anna, who will welcome you personally and help every guest feel at ease.

Halloween Singles Event in London: Your Questions

Everything you need to know about our masked Halloween evening for singles in Soho.

Where is the Halloween singles event in London?

A Masked Halloween Evening for Singles takes place at The Arts Theatre Club, 50 Frith Street, Soho, London W1D 4SQ, on Friday 30 October 2026. The evening starts at 6:30pm.

How much are tickets?

Tickets are £28 and include a complimentary welcome drink. A tarot reading is an optional extra at £10. Happy Hour drinks are £7 between 5:30pm and 9pm.

What is the age range?

The evening is for singles aged 28 and over.

Do I need a costume or a mask?

A masquerade mask is mandatory and can be bought on the night for a small fee. A full costume is entirely optional - glamour is encouraged.

What is included in the evening?

Every ticket includes a complimentary welcome drink, 80s and 90s music all evening and a beautifully atmospheric Soho setting. Tarot readings are available as an optional extra, with limited slots.

Who hosts the evening?

The evening is hosted by Sparked Connection's professional matchmaker, Anna, who welcomes guests personally. If someone catches your eye, simply let Anna know and she will take it from there.

How do I book a ticket?

Complete the short registration form on this page, then continue to secure payment. Your ticket is emailed to you as soon as you have paid.
